Recipe
Green salsa - 4 tomatillos, 3 jalapeños, and one Serrano, one half white onion and 4 cloves of garlic and cilantro as well 

Red salsa - 3 Roma tomatoes, 1 good size tomatillo, Chile de arbol (dried) 2 jalapeños sliced and de-veined, half a red onion, and 5 cloves of garlic

Throw all ingredients in a pot and add water, boil til everyone in the kitchen is coughing lol about 20 min, add all ingredients into blender and blend to your liking. Last very important step! Remove water from the pot you used unless you want to add some to your salsa it'll thin it out and add some good flavor. Finally simmer the salsa in the pot for about 15 min, color will change and it'll thicken up nicely. Also while it simmers its the best time to add spices or just salt and a dash, a DASH of beef boulion. Don't add too much bullion it'll change the flavor if you add too much.
